obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be considered only in the closed position
obligations.ears: The opening roofs shall be considered only in the closed position.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be examined with the hood in both the raised and lowered positions
obligations.ears: The convertible vehicles shall be examined with the hood in both the raised and lowered positions.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: no examination shall be made of the vehicle inside an imaginary surface formed by the hood when in the raised position
obligations.ears: When the hood is lowered, no examination shall be made of the vehicle inside an imaginary surface formed by the hood when in the raised position.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: the examination shall be made with the cover in position
obligations.ears: Where a cover for the linkage of the hood when folded is provided as standard equipment, the examination shall be made with the cover in position.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall comply with the following provisions in all positions of use
obligations.ears: The windows which move outwards from the external surface of the vehicle shall comply with the following provisions in all positions of use.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: No exposed edge shall face forwards
obligations.ears: In all positions of use, the window which moves outwards from the external surface of the vehicle shall have no exposed edge facing forwards.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: No part of the window shall project beyond the extreme outer edge of the vehicle
obligations.ears: In all positions of use, no part of the window which moves outwards from the external surface of the vehicle shall project beyond the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation
obligations.ears: When they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere with a registration plate fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation, the supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n6
obligations.response: shall be so attached to the vehicle that positive locking exists in at least one direction and that horizontal, longitudinal and transverse forces can be transmitted which are at least equal to the vertical load-bearing capacity of the rack as specified by its manufacturer
obligations.ears: The luggage racks and ski racks shall be so attached to the vehicle that positive locking exists in at least one direction and that horizontal, longitudinal and transverse forces can be transmitted which are at least equal to the vertical load-bearing capacity of the rack as specified by its manufacturer.

derived.text: The luggage racks and ski racks shall be so attached to the vehicle that positive locking exists in at least one direction.

The luggage racks and ski racks shall be so attached to the vehicle that horizontal, longitudinal and transverse forces can be transmitted which are at least equal to the vertical load-bearing capacity of the rack as specified by its manufacturer.

obligations.subject: n6
obligations.response: the test loads shall not be applied at one point only
obligations.ears: When the luggage rack or ski rack fixed to the vehicle according to the manufacturer's instructions is tested, the test loads shall not be applied at one point only.

obligations.subject: n6
obligations.response: shall not have parts with a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm
obligations.exception: unless the provisions of paragraph 6.3. can be applied
obligations.ears: When surfaces can be contacted by a sphere of 165 mm diameter after installation of the rack, the surfaces shall not have parts with a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.

obligations.subject: n7
obligations.response: shall not project more than 40 mm beyond the surfaces referred to in paragraph 6.16.2. above
obligations.ears: The fastening elements such as bolts that are tightened or loosened without tools shall not project more than 40 mm beyond the surfaces referred to in paragraph 6.16.2. above, the projection being determined according to the method prescribed in paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to this Regulation, but using a sphere of 165 mm diameter in those cases where the method prescribed in paragraph 2.2. of this annex is employed.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: it shall be inside the zone bounded by the vertical planes which are 10 cm inside the extreme outer edge of the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.7. of this Regulation
obligations.ears: When the unattached end of a radio receiving or transmitting aerial is less than 2 m from the road surface in any position of use specified by the manufacturer of the aerial, it shall be inside the zone bounded by the vertical planes which are 10 cm inside the extreme outer edge of the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.7. of this Regulation.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: no part of the aerials protrude beyond the extreme outer edge of the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.7. of this Regulation
obligations.ears: The aerials shall be so fitted to the vehicle, and if necessary their unattached ends so restricted, that no part of the aerials protrude beyond the extreme outer edge of the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.7. of this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n8
obligations.response: may have radii of curvature of less than 2.5 mm
obligations.ears: The shafts of aerials may have radii of curvature of less than 2.5 mm.

obligations.subject: n10
obligations.response: shall be fitted with fixed cappings, the radii of curvature of which are not less than 2.5 mm
obligations.ears: The unattached ends of aerials shall be fitted with fixed cappings, the radii of curvature of which are not less than 2.5 mm.

obligations.subject: n9
obligations.response: shall not project more than 40 mm
obligations.ears: The bases of aerials shall not project more than 40 mm when determined according to the procedure of paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: Paragraphs 6.17.4. and 6.17.4.1. above shall not apply
obligations.exception: provided that the maximum projection of the aerial including its housing does not exceed 70 mm when determined according to the procedure of paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to this Regulation
obligations.ears: When aerials are located behind the vertical transversal plane passing through the "R" point of the driver and the maximum projection of the aerial including its housing does not exceed 70 mm when determined according to the procedure of paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to this Regulation, paragraphs 6.17.4. and 6.17.4.1. above shall not apply.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: paragraph 6.17.4.1. above shall apply using a projection limit of 70 mm instead of 40 mm
obligations.ears: If the aerial is located behind that vertical plane but projects more than 70 mm, paragraph 6.17.4.1. above shall apply using a projection limit of 70 mm instead of 40 mm.
